unit: ATR(14) at the decision bar, as a fraction of price
measuredOn: the training and validation folds only; the test fold is not read here
whatThisIsNot: Not a prediction. The brain predicts the sign of the forward return and nothing else; these distances are what the market has done, not what it will do.
Not a backtest and not a profitability claim. No transaction cost, spread, funding or slippage is in any number here.
The hit rates are measured on rows where the direction turned out correct. A direction is right about half the time, so the unconditional rate is lower and is not what these numbers say.
